subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support reuse the existing `send` + `mediaUrls` message-tool shape, or introduce a separate explicit album action such as `send-media-group` with `filePaths`?
rationale: Current main already has a multi-media URL surface but no album send path; the open external draft proposes a parallel action, and repository policy favors avoiding duplicate tool/API paths without maintainer-confirmed direction.

options.title: Reuse `send` + `mediaUrls`
options.body: Implement automatic `sendMediaGroup` grouping for eligible multi-media sends on the existing action and keep non-groupable media on the current sequential fallback path.

options.title: Accept explicit album action
options.body: Let a PR add a separate `send-media-group` action only after maintainers approve the new tool surface and require docs plus live Telegram proof.

options.title: Defer album semantics
options.body: Keep current sequential multi-media delivery for now and leave album grouping open until the product value outweighs the added channel-specific API surface.

recommendation.title: Reuse `send` + `mediaUrls`
recommendation.body: Implement automatic `sendMediaGroup` grouping for eligible multi-media sends on the existing action and keep non-groupable media on the current sequential fallback path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already left the prior cleanup review on this exact issue and is the clearest visible decision-routing candidate in the discussion.
